b10: I would first check the catalog action for Xid 79, which says restart the node. Three nodes at once is a pattern, so I suspect a shared cause such as a driver rollout. I cordon and drain one node, but a rate limit and breaker stop a fleet-wide drain.
b09: Alert on burn rate, not raw errors. Page at 14.4 with a 1 h long window and a 5 min short window. Page at 6 for 6 h and 30 min. Open a ticket at burn 1 over 3 days.
